system.description: Prerequisite Charms: Katabatic Leap Defense, ThousandHailstone Morning The Exalt lightly flicks his hand, and his weapon hurtles toward his foe. Just before it strikes, the weapon dissolves into a swirling vortex of air that insinuates itself into the joints and cracks of the target's armor. As it works its way toward the victim's tender flesh, it re-coalesces. This Charm makes any thrown-weapon attack piercing. Thrown attacks made with weapons that already inflict piercing damage instead evade armor altogether. Night Breeze practitioners use this Charm almost exclusively to let their throwing needles evade Hardness.
